turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?
turns.patient_response: My doctor sent me here because my weight has gotten really low, and people around me are making a big fuss about it. I don’t really see it the same way, honestly. Being lighter feels like it helps me keep up in the shop and not get slowed down.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been intentionally limiting how much you eat, or do you worry about gaining weight?

symptom_reasoning.S043: The patient acknowledges intentionally limiting intake on workshop days to tea and only a few bites of food.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, even though you're already quite thin?

turns.doctor_question: Do you ever make yourself sick, use laxatives, or exercise excessively after eating to try to control your weight?

turns.patient_response: I’m not sure I’d say I exercise a lot. My work is physical, being on my feet and using my hands all day, but I don’t really go out of my way to work out to make up for eating.

symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient states they do not go out of their way to work out to make up for eating, denying excessive exercise as a compensatory behavior.
